_note: PFOH 3.1.0 snapshot field allow-list (data minimization). SnapshotFieldSpec must match this file. Output shape unchanged: db-dump.json {pulledAt, columns, tables{'dbo.X':{count, rows}}} and directory-users.json {pulledAt, users, signInActivity}. 'count' is the full table row count for EVERY user table; 'rows' are emitted ONLY for the tables below with ONLY the listed columns. Derived boolean presence flags replace free-text/photo content.

dbo.Honorees.rule: PhotoFileName trimmed non-empty AND lower(PhotoFileName) does not start with 'silhouette'
Description trimmed non-empty AND lower(trimmed) not in ('no information provided','n/a','none','unknown')

excluded_examples: bios/Description text, Awards text, ConflictsServed text, photo file names/content, addresses, Comment, PrintedBy, any other free text, all columns/tables not listed
